blocks.text: Leviticus 13 contains 59 verses. It opens with: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying, It concludes with: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: Leviticus distinguishes ritual impurity from moral offenses rather than treating every unclean condition as personal sin.
